smite.name: Smite
smite.desc: Basic Holy damage nuke with a cast time. Castable in Shadowform in Forever (Classic blocked it).

lesserheal.name: Lesser Heal
lesserheal.desc: Small, cheap direct heal with a cast time.

shoot.name: Shoot
shoot.desc: Auto-attack with your equipped wand (needs a wand).

swpain.name: Shadow Word: Pain
swpain.desc: Instant Shadow damage-over-time. In Forever its ticks can crit and get Shadowform's bigger crit bonus.

pwshield.name: Power Word: Shield
pwshield.desc: Instant absorb shield; target gets Weakened Soul (can't be shielded again for 15 sec).

renew.name: Renew
renew.desc: Instant heal over time. In Forever several priests' Renews can sit on one target.

fade.name: Fade
fade.desc: Temporarily drops your threat for 10 sec; threat reduction doubled in Forever.

mindblast.name: Mind Blast
mindblast.desc: Shadow damage nuke on a cooldown, high threat.

resurrection.name: Resurrection
resurrection.desc: Brings a dead player back to life out of combat.

innerfire.name: Inner Fire
innerfire.desc: 10-min self buff: armor (spell power at higher ranks), uses charges when hit.

psychicscream.name: Psychic Scream
psychicscream.desc: Instant AoE fear on nearby enemies; damage may break it.

curedisease.name: Cure Disease
curedisease.desc: Removes one disease from a friendly target. Forever: usable in Shadowform without dropping it.

heal.name: Heal
heal.desc: Mid-size direct heal with a cast time.

dispelmagic.name: Dispel Magic
dispelmagic.desc: Removes a harmful magic effect from a friend or a buff from an enemy.

mindsoothe.name: Mind Soothe
mindsoothe.desc: Shrinks a humanoid's aggro range so you can slip past it.

shackleundead.name: Shackle Undead
shackleundead.desc: Crowd control on one Undead target; breaks on damage.

fearward.name: Fear Ward
fearward.desc: Wards a friendly target against the next Fear. New for every priest race in Forever (was Dwarf-only).

devouringplague.name: Devouring Plague
devouringplague.desc: Instant disease DoT that heals you for the damage dealt. Forever: baseline for all priests (was Undead-only), 24 sec cooldown.

holyfire.name: Holy Fire
holyfire.desc: Slow Holy nuke plus a short burn. Castable in Shadowform in Forever.

mindvision.name: Mind Vision
mindvision.desc: See through the target's eyes for 1 min (scouting).

manaburn.name: Mana Burn
manaburn.desc: Burns the target's mana and deals Shadow damage for part of it.

bindingheal.name: Binding Heal
bindingheal.desc: Heals your target and yourself at once, 1.5 sec cast. New in Forever: was a Holy talent in beta, now trainer-taught at 25 (see unverified).

mindcontrol.name: Mind Control
mindcontrol.desc: Channel to take control of a humanoid.

prayerofhealing.name: Prayer of Healing
prayerofhealing.desc: Big group heal with a cast time. Forever: heals your target's party (and pets), not yours.

shadowprotection.name: Shadow Protection
shadowprotection.desc: Shadow resistance buff on one target.

divinespirit.name: Divine Spirit
divinespirit.desc: 1-hour Spirit buff. Forever: baseline at 30 (was a Discipline talent).

abolishdisease.name: Abolish Disease
abolishdisease.desc: Cleanses a disease now and every 5 sec for 20 sec. Forever: usable in Shadowform without dropping it.

swdeath.name: Shadow Word: Death
swdeath.desc: New in Forever: instant Shadow hit, 18 sec cooldown; if the target survives you take 30% of your max health.

levitate.name: Levitate
levitate.desc: Float, fall slowly and walk on water for 2 min.

prayeroffortitude.name: Prayer of Fortitude
prayeroffortitude.desc: Group/raid version of Power Word: Fortitude.

innerfocus.name: Inner Focus
innerfocus.desc: Next spell costs no mana and gets +25% crit chance (now only affects one spell).

penance.name: Penance
penance.desc: New in Forever: 2 sec channel, 12 sec cooldown; damages an enemy or heals an ally every second.

powerinfusion.name: Power Infusion
powerinfusion.desc: +20% spell damage and healing on a target for 15 sec.

holynova.name: Holy Nova
holynova.desc: Instant point-blank AoE: damages nearby enemies and heals nearby party members, no threat.

prayerofmending.name: Prayer of Mending
prayerofmending.desc: New in Forever: 10 sec cooldown heal that triggers when the target is hit, then jumps to another party member (5 heals).

mindflay.name: Mind Flay
mindflay.desc: 3 sec Shadow channel that slows the target by 50%.

vampiricembrace.name: Vampiric Embrace
vampiricembrace.desc: Debuff that heals your party for 20% of your Shadow damage. Forever: 30 sec duration, 30 sec cooldown, now the Shadow 16-point talent.

silence.name: Silence
silence.desc: Silences the target for 5 sec (interrupt). Forever: no longer needs Improved Psychic Scream.

shadowform.name: Shadowform
shadowform.desc: Shadow caster form: Shadow spells cost 50% less and crit harder, 15% less physical damage taken; no healing spells while in it.
